selection: One checkpoint per application/arm/seed, selected by equal-priority-property mean validation standardized MSE. Heat transfer: Cp, conductivity, ln(viscosity), MP, Td. CO2: ln(CO2), ln(viscosity), MP. Choose between fixed arms by five-seed mean of the same validation objective; no test selection.
protocol: User-selected 1M three-pass general-molecular pretraining; full encoder fine-tuning and unchanged eleven-head MLP. Fixed 90% total priority loss and 10% auxiliary loss, divided equally within groups. No weight search or new attention. Twenty fits: two applications x uniform/weighted x five seeds, matched initialization and balanced per-task sampling. Frozen complete-IL split and train-only standardization. Prespecified 200-epoch cap and patience 15. Historical 1M references use 100 epochs and other checkpoint criteria; they are contextual controls. The previous 30.2M heat-transfer study included Tg and used a 100-epoch cap, so it is not an initialization-only contrast. CO2/viscosity are trained in ln space; native CO2 and log-viscosity MAEs are displayed separately. Previously inspected test split: exploratory results, not independent chemical generalization.
inference: Weighted minus matched uniform: paired whole-IL bootstrap intervals and sign randomization for each application and all eleven properties, under row/equal-IL MAE weighting. BH across 44 tests only after all twenty fits finish. Intervals condition on the fitted models; no inferential selection of weights.
